content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Alex, don't push through it. Drop the deadlift load or pause it until your back is pain-free, and stop if the pain is sharp or lasts more than a few days. If it does, get it checked by a physio or doctor. Mild muscle soreness is normal, but pain in the lower back itself is not something to grind through. 💪
